transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Right, um, shall we start? It's the ninth. Everyone here?

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Here.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Here, yeah.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Hi, yeah, I'm here. Sorry, one second, I'm muting the other call.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: So last time we decided younger market, single device TV remote, twelve fifty budget. Today it's conceptual design. Each of us presents, then we pick directions.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Okay, can I go first? Because I have some sketches.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Please.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: So, um, I looked at two shapes. One is the flat rectangle, like every remote ever. The other is a curved case, kind of like a, a pebble, that sits in your hand.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Oh I like the pebble.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Mm, yeah, the curved one is nicer to hold, but, um, it affects where the buttons go.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Right, you'd have a sort of dip in the middle. And I'd do it with a rubber coating, so it's soft and not slippery.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: How much does the rubber add to the cost?

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Um, not much I think, but I don't have an actual number.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: I can ask. I have a contact at a plastics firm. I'll try to get a quote for the rubber coating, but, um, they're not always quick.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Okay, Hannah will try. Don't stress about a date.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Yeah.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: So who's for the curved case with rubber coating?

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Me.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Yes, me too.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Yeah, obviously.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Good, so that's decided, curved case with a rubber coating.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Cool. So from my side, the interface. I looked at the usual remotes and, yeah, the volume and channel buttons are, they are the most used.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Mm.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: And I was thinking, um, a scroll wheel. Like on the old music players. One wheel does volume and channel, you press the side to switch.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: That would actually save space. Two fewer buttons.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Would people understand it though? My mum would not.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Well, we'd put icons, plus and minus. It's, I think it's intuitive.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Hmm. I mean, are we okay with the scroll wheel instead of the volume and channel buttons?

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Okay, yeah, if it has icons.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Yeah, definitely icons.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Alright, scroll wheel, that's decided. Leo, you'll turn that into a layout mock-up?

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Sure. I'll build the button layout mock-up and have it ready by end of the week.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: End of the week, so Friday the thirteenth.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Friday, yeah.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Can I do the trends, quickly?

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: So the trend watching, um, fashion says, fruit and vegetables. Like, spongy, bright colours, the whole thing. And, uh, the thing that is, that they, that people keep saying is "fancy".

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Bright colours, okay, that works with the rubber.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: I'll send the full trend watching report around Wednesday, it's mostly written.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Wednesday the eleventh. Good.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Yep.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Now, batteries. Last time we said someone has to check, who did we say?

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: We didn't. It's still open. Who is going to check the battery thickness with the supplier?

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Honestly I'd say whoever has the supplier relationship.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Which is nobody here.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Yeah. It's open. I'll flag it to the management.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: For the case I'm assuming a single AA battery for now. If it's two AAA we might need to redo it.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Does single AA work for everyone?

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Yes, no impact on me.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Fine.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Okay, single AA, decided for now.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Okay good. And for my part, I'll do a clay model of the casing so we can hold it. I want to bring it to the next meeting. So the prototype casing model, in clay, I'd say by Friday as well.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Friday the thirteenth. That's your deliverable then.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Oh, you know what, maybe we should test the prototype on a few people? Like grab five colleagues, hand them the clay thing and see if it feels right.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Ooh, that's a good idea. We should do that.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: It is a good idea. I'd say let's keep it as an idea, I can't say who has time. We can see after the models exist.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Okay, yeah, that's fair.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: What did we say about the, the colour? Just so I know for the clay.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Clay's grey, doesn't matter. Colour is later.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Right. I think that's it. Anything else? Leo, the last time you, um, said you were swamped, are you okay with Friday?

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Yeah, yeah, it's fine. The other project finished.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Good. Then we're done. Thanks everybody.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Bye.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: See you.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Oh, and, um, I'll send the meeting minutes tonight but it's nothing special.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Fine.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Great.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: And Priya, once more, the model is the clay model, yes? Not the, not the CAD.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: The clay one. Right. The clay prototype, I'll make that.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Good. Bye.

decisions.text: Use a curved case with a rubber coating
Use a single AA battery layout for now
A scroll wheel replaces the volume and channel buttons
